question: Before we start — what problem is this solving, and for whom?
whyHelp:
Here is why this matters right now:
A clear problem statement is what keeps the build from drifting.
Two minutes naming the goal makes every later step easier.

L1.title: Who is this for, and what problem does it solve?
L1.body: Before building anything, get clear on two things: who's going to use this, and what problem or frustration does it fix for them? Write two or three sentences answering both — no technical words needed, just the plain idea.

L2.title: Who's it for, and what problem does it fix?
L2.body: Who is this for, and what problem does it solve? Write a couple of sentences — keep it simple, no tech talk needed.

L3.title: Who's it for? What problem?
L3.body: Who's it for? What problem does it fix? Write it in plain words.
